verdict.rationale: Migrating historical books is a fair question for accounting software, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no import tool, migration service, or conversion path from another accounting system. The Journal Entries and other write APIs are only developer building blocks someone could use to build a migration, and the bookkeeping service never mentions data migration, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail
